lines.zh: 我浮着走，靴尖离地一寸。
lines.en: I drift along, boot tips an inch off the ground.

lines.zh: 金色的气在身后拖成一条线。
lines.en: Golden ki trails behind me in a line.

lines.zh: 发梢笔直向上，一步都不乱。
lines.en: My hair points straight up, unmoved by each step.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，石头自己裂开。
lines.en: Stones crack on their own where I pass.

lines.zh: 手臂绷着，随时能抬起来。
lines.en: My arms stay taut, ready to rise.

lines.zh: 我步子很稳，像在丈量什么。
lines.en: My steps are steady, as if measuring something.
My cape churns in my aura.
I circle to the upwind side.
My ki presses the grass flat.

lines.zh: 我走得不急，赢定了才会急。
lines.en: I do not hurry; only the losing hurry.

lines.zh: 每走一段，我就看一眼天。
lines.en: Every so often I glance at the sky.
My shadow stretches long beneath me.
I stand with my arms folded.
The corner of my mouth turns down.
My aura pushes out in rings.
I am waiting for my opponent to move first.
I do not care about the wait.
I drum my fingers on my arm.
Ki sits tight in my chest.
Gold light spills over the grass.
I am even reckoning the wind.

lines.zh: 我抱着手，气在脚边慢慢转。
lines.en: Arms folded, my aura turns slowly at my feet.
Dust swirls at my feet.
No one keeps me waiting long.
I sweep my cape back.
I look at you sidelong.
There is little ki in you.

lines.zh: 这种程度也敢站在这儿。
lines.en: You dare stand here at this level?

lines.zh: 我比你高出一个头，别仰着看。
lines.en: I stand a head taller; don't strain your neck.
You are in my way.

lines.zh: 我打量你一下，就不看了。
lines.en: I glance once and look away.
I gesture for you to back off.
If you are smart, you will leave.
I smile, and it is not pleasant.

lines.zh: 六亿五千万，这数字我记着。
lines.en: Six hundred fifty million; I remember.
I see it perfectly.
Say what you want to say.
I have little patience.

lines.zh: 我转身之前，又看了你一眼。
lines.en: Before I turn, I glance at you once more.
Remember it.
Next time, do not block me.
I growl low.
You knocked the prince's face aside.
My ki scatters for an instant.
I wipe it away.
I am still standing.
I push myself up off my knee.
That's it? I haven't even raised my ki.

lines.zh: 这种程度的伤，不值一提。
lines.en: Damage like this isn't worth mentioning.

lines.zh: 我不需要别人给的东西。
lines.en: I do not need what others hand me.
I can take it myself.
The prince of Saiyans takes no charity.
One glance; I do not move.

lines.zh: 赛亚人吃得很多，但我现在不饿。
lines.en: Saiyans eat a lot, but I am not hungry now.
What is this supposed to be?
I laugh once and walk on.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西也能打，别献殷勤。
lines.en: I can fight without eating; save your offerings.
Fighting matters more than eating.

lines.zh: 你撞在我肩上，被弹开了。
lines.en: You hit my shoulder and are thrown back.
My aura pushes you back half a step.

lines.zh: 我侧了侧身，算给你面子。
lines.en: I turn slightly, and that is courtesy enough.
Do not touch my cape.
You stepped on my shadow.
I move you aside.
The ground splits in a line.
I do not stop.
I shake my head.

lines.zh: 我不是来这儿谈情说爱的。
lines.en: I did not come here for romance.
My goal is to surpass him.
Everything else comes after.
I throw the thoughts aside.
My ki gathers again.
That is all.
I walk on.
Useless.
I toss it back.
I stow it in my pouch.
I squeeze it; it is brittle.
I wiped it clean.
I throw it in my pack.
Trash.
I turn and go.
The prince of Saiyans raises his head.
At last, a worthy one.
I mark it.
My aura leaps higher.
Six hundred fifty million. Don't test it.
Let it move first.
I watch its shoulders.
I want this fight clean.

lines.zh: 地面在我脚下塌了一点。
lines.en: The ground sags beneath me.
Six hundred fifty million — enough?

lines.zh: 让我看看你配不配当对手。
lines.en: Show me whether you're worth fighting.

lines.zh: 六亿五千万的战力，够了吗？
lines.en: Six hundred fifty million power; is that enough?

lines.zh: 指尖亮起小气弹，只一颗。
lines.en: A small ki blast lights at my fingertip, just one.
Ki lights in my palm.
It will regret standing here.
I move with its rhythm.
It punches; I yield half an inch.
Small ki blasts fly from my fingers.
One after another.
It backs against stone.
Its ki is fraying.
Too slow.
It turns; I am already at its flank.
I gather ki into my fist.
Its opening is the left shoulder.
One blow will do.
The wind is cut.

lines.zh: 大爆炸攻击，收尾用这个。
lines.en: Big Bang Attack; this one ends it.
My fist lands and the ground dents.
A kick lands at its waist.
I catch its arm and twist.

lines.zh: 我连打三拳，一拳比一拳重。
lines.en: Three punches, each heavier.

lines.zh: 它挡了，我从下面打进去。
lines.en: It blocks high; I strike low.
My knee drives into its gut.
I follow with an elbow.
It skids back several blocks.

lines.zh: 我的拳套擦过，你的胸甲裂开。
lines.en: My glove grazes you and your chestplate splits.

lines.zh: 一拳砸下，地面陷了半格。
lines.en: One punch down, the ground sinks half a block.
It swings back; I tilt my head.
I pin its foot.

lines.zh: 我抓住它的领口，往地面砸。
lines.en: I grab its collar and drive it into the ground.
This one carries all my ki.
I let go.

lines.zh: 气先压下来，然后我才出现。
lines.en: The pressure comes first; then I appear.
I land and the soil curls in a ring.

lines.zh: 金色的光从脚底升到头顶。
lines.en: Gold light climbs from my feet to my crown.

lines.zh: 金色气柱冲上天，鸟全飞了。
lines.en: A golden pillar of ki shoots up; the birds scatter.
I dislike quiet.
The wind pulls my cape straight.

lines.zh: 云被我的气冲开一个洞。
lines.en: My ki punches a hole in the clouds.
That is more like it.
I take one step forward.
The grass all falls.
I hear movement far off.
Then let us have a fight.
I bare my teeth in a grin.
My aura ignites.

lines.zh: 火扑到身上，气把它挡住。
lines.en: Fire strikes; my ki holds it off.
I hit the ground and earth sprays up.
Water floods my lungs; I hold my ki.
The blast sends me sliding.
It grazes my ribs.

lines.zh: 咒力缠住脚踝，我挣断了。
lines.en: Magic coils round my ankles; I snap it.
My stomach growls; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 雷落在肩上，我把它散了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my shoulder; I disperse it.
Nothing below; I push up on ki.
